title: DeForest Buckner is on the mend, could return in training camp

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: DeForest Buckner is on the mend, could return in training camp
sources.description: Colts defensive tackle DeForest Buckner underwent surgery earlier this offseason to repair a herniated disc that led to a compressed nerve in his neck.
